blocks.text: Hoarding Cleanout Services in Newmarket, Ontario — Cleared With Care, Never Judgment

c: Reaching out about a hoarding situation is hard — whether it’s your home, a parent’s, or a property you’re responsible for. {{fact:changedScope}}. No lectures, no reactions, no judgment. Just a fully insured Newmarket team that has done this many times before and knows how to do it kindly.

blocks.text: The Crew Newmarket Families Call When a Home Needs a Fresh Start

Hoarding touches more households than most people realize — in every neighbourhood, from Main Street to Stonehaven, behind doors that look like every other door on the street. Live Junk Free has spent years helping Newmarket families through it quietly, and the Google reviews behind our name include many from people who were nervous to make the first call and grateful they did.

We arrive without fanfare, keep conversations private, and treat what we see as nobody's business but yours. Neighbours see a crew doing a job — nothing more. What's discussed during your walkthrough stays between us.

Some hoarding cleanouts run start-to-finish in a day; others go better as a series of shorter visits, one room at a time, with the resident involved in decisions. Both are normal. We build the plan around the person, not around our schedule.

Pricing is based on the volume we remove — never on hours. That matters enormously here, because it means slowing down to check every box and pocket costs you nothing extra. The figure from your free walkthrough is locked, period.

Hoarded homes hide important things: cash, jewelry, documents, photographs, keepsakes. Our crew is trained to sort as we go, not scoop — anything significant is set aside and handed to you or the family. It's slower, and it's the only right way to do this work.

The walkthrough is free and private, the quote carries no obligation, and if you or your family member aren't ready, we'll leave our number and wait. Many of our Newmarket hoarding cleanouts started with a call months before the actual booking. That's fine with us.
Big-brand chains charge premium rates for "specialty" cleanouts and add royalties on top.
Honest Pricing for a Sensitive Job
Volume-Based, Flat, and Settled Privately Up Front
There's no "hoarding surcharge," no hourly meter punishing and no revised bill afterward.
How a Hoarding Cleanout Unfolds — Gently, and In Order
There's a rhythm to doing this well. Here's ours:

items.title: 1. A Private Conversation First
text: Call +1 647 922 5865 — you'll speak with someone who has handled these situations before, not a call centre script. Tell us as much or as little as you're comfortable with, and we'll arrange a discreet walkthrough at a time that suits you or your family.

items.title: 2. A Calm Walkthrough and a
text: We tour the home quietly, without commentary, and assess the volume involved. You receive one figure — and if a phased, room-by-room approach makes more sense, we'll map that out together. The quote is free and carries zero pressure.

items.title: 3. Clearing That Respects the Person
text: {{fact:cleanupScope}}. Donations are staged separately from disposal at every stage.

items.title: 4. A Clean, Home Again
text: Cleared rooms are as we finish them. When the final load leaves, the home is ready for deep cleaning, repairs or simply living in again — and everything removed is routed to donation and recycling first, landfill strictly last.

blocks.text: Hoarding Support for Every Situation Newmarket Families Face

Frequently Asked Questions About Hoarding Cleanouts in Newmarket, ON

items.q: Q: How much does a hoarding cleanout cost in Newmarket?
a: {{fact:changedScope}}.

items.q: Q: Will the neighbours know what's happening?
a: A: Not from us. Our crews arrive and work without drawing attention, conversations stay private, and from the street it looks like any routine junk removal job. Discretion is standard on every hoarding call, not something you need to ask for.

items.q: Q: My parent isn't fully ready for this. Can it happen gradually?
a: A: Yes, and gradual often works best. We can start with a single room or simply clearing safe pathways, let the resident be part of every keep-or-go decision, and return for additional visits as comfort grows. There’s no pressure to do everything at once — and no penalty in the pricing for splitting it up.

items.q: Q: What if there's money, jewelry or important paperwork buried in the house?
a: A: We assume there is — because there almost always is. {{fact:changedScope}}. Finding a missing document or an envelope of cash is a regular occurrence on these jobs.

items.q: Q: Can you handle a hoarded home after a family member has passed away?
a: A: We can, and we do so often.
